auth.users (local stand-in table for auth schema)

organizations table (multi-tenant root)
branches table (agency branches per organization)
properties table (biens: building/house/plot)
units table (apartment/office/shop/parking, status, rent_amount)
contacts table (person/company)
contact_roles table (owner/renter/buyer, glossary N-09)
ownerships table (effective-dated unit shares without overlap)

current_ownerships view (owners of each unit as of today in Tunisia)
record_gaps view (one row per missing info for 'Fiches incomplètes')
property-files storage bucket (10 MB, presigned downloads)

today_tunis() (database 'today' always Tunisia)
assign_lease_number() (advisory-locked per-organization lease numbering)
guard_lease_update() trigger (erp.lease_action flag; non-draft leases immutable via clients)
lease_units table (units of a lease, draft-only child rows)
lease_parties table (renters and guarantors)
ensure_renter_role() trigger (renting grants contact role 'renter')
lease_rents table (effective-dated rent and charges per unit)
lease_terms table (initial term + one row per renewal)
lease_files table (signed lease, ID documents, registration receipt)
check_lease_file_storage() (legacy bucket='lease-files' + uploader validation)
sync_unit_status(p_unit) (rented/vacant follows active leases, row-locked)
assert_no_lease_overlap() (per-unit advisory locks, occupied-period overlap exclusion)
lease_session_org(p_session) (only org_admin/manager may act, org from session json)
activate_lease() (draft->active: needs renter, unit, rent; logs initial term)
renew_lease() (extends end_date, logs renewal term, optional new rents)
end_lease() (active->ended with real ended_on date and reason)
change_rent() (new effective-dated rent row on an active lease)
expire_overdue_leases() (daily job: active past end_date + grace -> expired_auto)
lease_overview view (list/fiche/dashboard row with all flags precomputed)
current_lease_rents view (current and next rent per leased unit)
unit_current_lease view (active lease(s) of each unit with renters and rent)
appointments table (viewing/move_in/move_out/meeting, assigned staff, unit/lease links)

notifications table (per-staff, dedupe_key idempotency, lease/appointment links)
check_appointment_staff() (assigned staff must be org_admin/manager of same org)
drop_stale_appointment_reminders() (cancel/move/done deletes bell reminders)
staff_members view (org_admin/manager per org from auth.users metadata + user_roles)
calendar_feed view (appointments + all-day lease events start/end/registration deadline)
generate_daily_notifications() (daily job: lease flags + tomorrow's appointments -> notifications)
listings table (annonces: rent/sale, draft/published/paused/closed)
check_listing_publishable() (archived/rentable/sellable/price/photo rules)
close_rent_listings_on_lease_active() (lease activation takes units off the market)
close_listings_on_unit_archived() (archived unit closes all its listings)
public_listings view (0005: listings joined to units/properties/photos, rounded coords)
public_listing_photos view (cover-first ordered public photos)
units website columns (title, description, sale_price, charges, amenities, show_on_website)
public_listings rebuild (row id = unit id; visibility criteria from unit fields)
unit/property visitor details (bedrooms, property_condition, legal_status, energy_class, year_built...)
public_listings 0007 (exposes visitor details instead of constants)
phone_digits() (phone reduced to digits for abuse throttling)
rental_requests table (start date + duration, status new/contacted/accepted/declined/closed)
visit_requests table (day/time slot, one confirmed visit per unit slot)
check_visitor_request() (unit on website, validate fields, throttle abuse)
submit_rental_request() (public mutation: rental request for a unit offered for rent)
submit_visit_request() (public mutation: visit slot Mon-Sat 09:00-17:30 half-hour)
notify_staff_of_request() trigger (inserts one notification for every staff member)
public_taken_visit_slots view (confirmed future slots, no personal data)
current_client_id() (client user id from hasura session)
require_client_on_request() trigger (REQUEST_LOGIN_REQUIRED; sets client_user_id)
units.visit_fee column (optional prepaid visit fee, rent only)
organizations.visit_payment_method (virtual/manual; null = free)
public_listings 0012 (adds visit_fee and visit_payment_method)
